item.title: Modernize your legacy WCF services: Automated migration to ASP.NET Core Web API using AWS Transform custom
item.description: Enterprises who need to migrate business-critical Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) services to ASP.NET Core Web API sometimes struggle with the scope of the change. These services still run on .NET Framework, the pool of engineers fluent in service contracts keep shrinking, and modern .NET does not support WCF.
